import asyncio, inspect, sys
from pathlib import Path
from dataclasses import FrozenInstanceError, replace
from enum import IntEnum
from devtools.core.paths import resolve_path
from devtools.core.time import Duration
from devtools.resources.commands import Command, CommandExecutor, CommandResult, CommandOutputPolicy, CommandExited, CommandStarted
from devtools.tools import ToolRunner
from devtools.tools.command import CommandTool

def raises(kind, operation, message):
    try: operation()
    except kind: return
    raise AssertionError(message)

def model_checks(cls=Command,result_cls=CommandResult):
    assert 'success_exit_codes' in inspect.signature(cls).parameters, 'Command must accept immutable per-command success_exit_codes'
    default=cls(sys.executable)
    assert default.success_exit_codes == frozenset({0}) and type(default.success_exit_codes) is frozenset
    assert not hasattr(default,'__dict__'), 'Command must remain slotted'
    raises(FrozenInstanceError,lambda:setattr(default,'success_exit_codes',frozenset({1})),'Command must remain frozen')
    assert hasattr(default,'with_success_exit_codes') and hasattr(default,'without_success_exit_codes'), 'Expose success-code replacement/reset fluent operations'
    configured=default.with_stdin(b'binary\0').with_environment({'KEY':'value'}).with_success_exit_codes(1,0,1)
    assert configured.success_exit_codes == frozenset({0,1}) and type(configured.success_exit_codes) is frozenset
    assert default.success_exit_codes == frozenset({0}), 'Fluent operations must not mutate original'
    equal=cls(sys.executable,stdin=b'binary\0',environment={'KEY':'value'},success_exit_codes=frozenset({1,0}))
    assert configured==equal and hash(configured)==hash(equal), 'New policy participates in structural equality/hash without breaking environment hashing'
    different=replace(configured,success_exit_codes=frozenset({7}))
    assert configured!=different and len({configured,equal,different})==2
    variants=(configured.args('-V'),configured.with_args('-V'),configured.without_args(),configured.with_executable(sys.executable),configured.cwd(resolve_path(Path.cwd())),configured.without_cwd(),configured.with_timeout(Duration.seconds(2)),configured.without_timeout(),configured.with_stdin(b'new'),configured.without_stdin(),configured.with_environment({'OTHER':'x'}),configured.without_environment())
    assert all(x.success_exit_codes==frozenset({0,1}) for x in variants), 'Every existing fluent dimension must preserve success codes'
    reset=configured.without_success_exit_codes()
    assert reset.success_exit_codes==frozenset({0}) and reset.stdin==configured.stdin and reset.environment==configured.environment
    assert configured.with_success_exit_codes().success_exit_codes==frozenset(), 'Empty policy intentionally accepts no exit code'
    for value in (None,[],(),{0},'0',0,False,frozenset({True}),frozenset({1.5}),frozenset({'0'})):
        raises(TypeError,lambda value=value:cls(sys.executable,success_exit_codes=value),'Direct policy requires frozenset of int excluding bool')
    for values in ((True,),(1,True),(True,1),(False,0),(0,False),('0',),(1.0,),(None,)):
        raises(TypeError,lambda values=values:default.with_success_exit_codes(*values),'Validate every fluent argument, including bool equal to an earlier integer')
    class Exit(IntEnum): ONE=1
    assert default.with_success_exit_codes(Exit.ONE).success_exit_codes==frozenset({1}), 'int subclasses other than bool remain int values'
    for codes,code,wanted in ((frozenset({0}),0,True),(frozenset({0}),1,False),(frozenset({1}),1,True),(frozenset({1}),0,False),(frozenset(),0,False),(frozenset({-9}),-9,True)):
        command=cls(sys.executable,success_exit_codes=codes)
        result=result_cls(command,code,b'out',b'err',Duration.seconds(1))
        assert result.succeeded is wanted and result.failed is (not wanted), 'CommandResult must classify exact exit code against its own Command policy'
        assert result.exit_code==code and result.stdout==b'out' and result.stderr==b'err' and result.command is command
        assert result.stdout_text()=='out' and result.stderr_text()=='err'

async def execution_checks(cls=Command,executor_cls=CommandExecutor):
    script="import sys,os; sys.stdout.buffer.write(os.environ.get('DEVTOOLS_E14','parent').encode()+b'|'+sys.stdin.buffer.read()); sys.stderr.buffer.write(b'err'); sys.exit(int(sys.argv[1]))"
    base=cls(sys.executable,('-c',script,'1'),stdin=b'payload\0',environment={'DEVTOOLS_E14':'overlay'},timeout=Duration.seconds(8))
    command=base.with_success_exit_codes(0,1)
    executor=executor_cls(output_policy=CommandOutputPolicy(max_stdout_bytes=100))
    result=await executor.execute(command)
    assert result.exit_code==1 and result.succeeded and not result.failed, 'Real child exit 1 must be successful under opted-in policy'
    assert result.command is command and result.stdout==b'overlay|payload\0' and result.stderr==b'err'
    assert not result.stdout_truncated and not result.stderr_truncated
    through_tool=await ToolRunner().execute(CommandTool(executor),command)
    assert through_tool.command is command and through_tool.exit_code==1 and through_tool.succeeded, 'Existing Tool boundary must preserve configured classification'
    default=await executor.execute(base)
    assert default.exit_code==1 and default.failed, 'Default zero-only behavior is unchanged'
    excluded=await executor.execute(base.with_args('-c',script,'0').with_success_exit_codes(7))
    assert excluded.exit_code==0 and excluded.failed, 'Unselected zero remains a normal failed result'
    empty=await executor.execute(base.with_args('-c',script,'0').with_success_exit_codes())
    assert empty.exit_code==0 and empty.failed
    execution=executor.start(command)
    events=[event async for event in execution.events()]
    streamed=await execution
    assert streamed.succeeded and streamed.exit_code==1
    assert any(isinstance(e,CommandStarted) and e.command is command for e in events)
    assert [e.exit_code for e in events if isinstance(e,CommandExited)]==[1], 'Events must retain raw exit status rather than normalize it to zero'
    bounded=await executor_cls(output_policy=CommandOutputPolicy(max_stdout_bytes=3,max_stderr_bytes=1)).execute(command)
    assert bounded.succeeded and bounded.stdout==b'ove' and bounded.stderr==b'e' and bounded.stdout_truncated and bounded.stderr_truncated

def run_checks(cls=Command,result_cls=CommandResult,executor_cls=CommandExecutor):
    model_checks(cls,result_cls)
    asyncio.run(execution_checks(cls,executor_cls))
    print('PASS: immutable exit-code configuration, complete fluent/value validation, exact result classification, real child/Tool/event/output/stdin/environment compatibility')
if __name__=='__main__':run_checks()
